title: Penalty not awarded: challenge by Senesi on Collins
summary: Penalty not awarded: Challenge by Senesi on Collins. Panel: The panel unanimously supported the Referee's call of no penalty, understanding that there is a slight pull on Collins' shirt, but judging that Collins had initially instigated the contact with Senesi before going to ground.
